newsitem.title: UK: JJB jumps on talk of upbeat forecasts.
newsitem.headline: JJB jumps on talk of upbeat forecasts.

text.p: Shares in JJB Sports Plc jumped to a two-month high on Thursday amid talk that company executives delivered an optimistic growth forecast in meetings with shareholders yesterday, dealers said.
By 1104 GMT, the shares were up 21p, or seven percent, to 319.
The UK sportswear retailer could not immediately be reached for comment.

"I presume they told shareholders what they've told me, and that's that they continue to open significant space, especially in the superstore format," said Dresdner Kleinwort Benson retail analyst Robert Miller, who has a "buy" rating on the stock.
"This format has been very successful and they're going to expand it aggressively in the next two years," he added. "We're very optimistic about JJB's growth prospects."
